title: לוי סבא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: Levi the Elder. Resh Lakish said in Levi the Elder's name, Eruvin (97b), Ḥullin (29b). R. Shimon said (perhaps it should read ben Lakish) in R. Levi the Elder's name: slaughter takes effect only at its completion. R. Yoḥanan says it takes effect from beginning to end, Merubbeh (72a). Perhaps he is Levi bar Sisi, but we have not found Resh Lakish speaking in his name.
